note: Reading programs: one shape. COURSE is always a theme; LESSON is always one book, or one PART of a long book named with the book; SUB-LESSON is the key point stated as a claim. The Charisma Myth and Do Hard Things had been shaped the other way round by the corpus planner (course = the book, lessons = concept clusters), which is why neither could ever build a book deck - buildBookDeck is lesson-scoped. Claim names are grounded in each source's own text; the Spiritual ones in their existing book-deck card backs.

books.book: The Charisma Myth by Olivia Fox Cabane

parts.rename: The Charisma Myth — Charisma as Learned Behavior

points.Charisma as learned nonverbal behavior: Charisma is learned behavior, not a birth gift — Steve Jobs practiced into it
points.Indirect body language control via menta: You cannot fake body language, so change the mental state driving it
points.Placebo-like belief effects: An internal charismatic state works like a placebo: belief produces the effect
points.Vivid imagination as reality: The brain cannot tell imagination from reality, so what you vividly imagine lands

points.Presence and undivided attention: Presence is the main charisma: being completely with the person in front of you
points.Mind-wandering prevalence and cost: We mind-wander half our waking hours, and the other person feels it
points.Attention as a charismatic signal: Five minutes of undivided attention is enough to bond with a stranger

parts.rename: The Charisma Myth — Power, Warmth and Style

points.Power-warmth combination: Charisma is power plus warmth, and either one alone falls flat
points.Warmth-plus-power advantage: Gladstone made her feel he was clever; Disraeli made her feel she was
points.Four charisma styles: There are four charisma styles: focus, visionary, kindness and authority
points.Style fit to personality goals and situa: Pick a style that fits your own personality: Kerry dumbed his down and lost

points.First impression formation and persisten: You get one first impression and it colours the whole relationship
points.Confirmation over revision: People work to confirm a first impression rather than revise it
points.Similarity and mirroring in rapport: People trust those who seem like them, so mirror their manner and language
points.Dress and language alignment: Dress and speak like the room: the black suit at a casual firm cost her

parts.rename: The Charisma Myth — Clearing Internal Obstacles

points.Dedramatizing negative emotions: Dedramatize: this is not serious, and plenty of others have felt it too
points.Destigmatizing shame: Shame is a normal part of being human, not evidence that you are flawed
points.Neutralizing self-judgment: Your mind does not report reality accurately, so a negative thought is not a fact
points.Prevent-recognize-remedy discomfort prot: Handle discomfort in three moves: prevent it, recognize it, remedy or explain it

points.State generation before body language: Generate the inner state first and the charismatic body language follows
points.Visualization for confident states: Visualize the win in vivid detail and your body arrives already confident
points.Anxiety reduction through outcome listin: Listing every outcome, disaster included, drains the anxiety out of them
points.Reality-rewriting by alternative outcome: Rewriting reality works on the brain's own confusion of imagined and real

books.book: Do Hard Things by Steve Magness

parts.rename: Do Hard Things — Ditch the Facade

points.Expectation-reality calibration: Toughness is calibration, not confidence: the overconfident readers quit first
points.Doubt as calibration data: Doubt is data: it signals your expectations have outrun your capability
points.Authentic versus overconfident goals: Goals set to impress other people do not survive contact with difficulty
points.Raising the floor goal setting: Raise the floor instead of lowering the bar: set a target you will beat

parts.rename: Do Hard Things — Listening to Your Body

points.Interoceptive awareness: Interoception, the skill of reading your own body, is what toughness rests on
points.Signal interpretation under pressure: Stockbrokers who read their own feelings out-earned and outlasted the stoics
points.Cognitive reappraisal of arousal: Emotions are the brain's first line of defense, not a weakness to suppress
points.Excitement-versus-anxiety labeling: Sweaty palms are excitement or anxiety depending only on which you call it

parts.lesson: Creating Space Between Impulse and Action
parts.rename: Do Hard Things — Space Between Stimulus and Response

points.Stimulus-response spacing through mindfu: Meditators felt the same pain three times less unpleasant, by making space
points.Pain intensity versus unpleasantness: Intensity and unpleasantness are separate, and you can change the second
points.Calm self-talk protocol: A calm inner conversation beats push-through-it, which doubles the pain
points.Reflexive escalation reduction: Telling yourself to ignore pain makes it louder — the double-down effect

parts.lesson: Working with Inner Voices Under Stress
parts.rename: Do Hard Things — Your Inner Voices

points.Temporal distancing time-out: Ask how this will feel in ten years and the stimulus shrinks to size
points.Hearing destructive voices without obeyi: Do not silence the destructive voice; ignoring it only makes it louder
points.Inner-voice role separation: Callahan survived by splitting into a desperate crewman and a stoic captain
points.Role separation during inner conflict: Let the desperate voice vent, then let the rational voice decide

parts.lesson: Sustaining Effort Through Motivation and Meaning
parts.rename: Do Hard Things — Drive and Purpose

points.Intrinsic versus extrinsic motivation: Pay people to build and they stop when the money stops: intrinsic motivation lasts
points.Purpose as endurance fuel: Purpose is what lets you empty the tank further than other people can
points.Post-traumatic growth and purpose: The POWs held longest grew the most: shattered assumptions can reveal purpose

parts.lesson: The Moral Law and the Case for God

points.The universal moral law: Nobody argues the rule is wrong, only that they are the exception
points.Critiquing cultural relativism: Moral truths are like multiplication tables: taught, but not invented
points.Moral law as evidence for theism: A chance universe cannot care whether you are fair, but the moral law does
points.Limits of scientific explanation: Science describes how the universe behaves, never why it exists at all
points.Lewis's trilemma: Lord, liar, or lunatic: Lord, liar or lunatic — great moral teacher is not on the menu
points.Historical context of Lewis's wartime br: Lewis broadcast common decency to Britain in 1942, while the bombs fell

books.course: The Reliability and Canon of Scripture
books.book: The Historical Reliability of the Bible

parts.lesson: Introduction to Biblical Reliability and Canonicity
parts.rename: The Historical Reliability of the Bible

points.Definition of canon: Canon means measuring rod: the exclusive list that sets the standard
points.Apocryphal and Gnostic literature: Apocryphal means outside the list, not necessarily heretical
points.Textual reliability and the Dead Sea Scr: Absence of evidence is not absence: Marco Polo never mentioned the Great Wall
points.Canon differences across Christian tradi: 66, 73, 76-81 or 88 books — but the New Testament never changes
points.Historical reliability of the Bible: Its messy history is the evidence for the Bible, not the problem with it
points.The Bible's influence on Western civiliz: Intrinsic human worth is a biblical idea the modern West still runs on

books.course: God, AI, and the Future of Humanity
books.book: John Lennox on AI and the image of God

parts.lesson: AI, Transhumanism, and the Image of God
parts.rename: John Lennox on AI and the Image of God

points.Narrow AI versus artificial general inte: Narrow AI does one thing; AGI would do everything, and is still a pipe dream
points.Transhumanism and human self-deification: Transhumanism is ancient self-deification with new tools: cure death, engineer gods
points.Humans made in the image of God: The image of God is what grounds human dignity, and transhumanism cuts it away
points.Mathematics as evidence for a word-based: Maths works and DNA is code: the universe looks word-based
points.AI worship and the danger of treating ma: AI looks omniscient and omnipresent, but it is a zombie god with no consciousness
points.Christian faith and the scientific commu: If your brain is an unguided accident, why trust its reasoning about anything
